messages:
Samir: quick handoff — active multi-alerts across embeddings + routing in eu-west. seeing ~3.2x error-rate on embed-prod (5xx) since ~22:04 UTC. top customer impact: AcmeCorp and BetaDocs experiencing failed uploads and timeouts. :rotating_light:

OpsBot: INCIDENT #INC-2026-84 — embeddings-service (eu-west) high-5xx-rate — triggered at 2026-03-15T22:04:12Z — severity: p1 — pages sent.

Samir: tl;dr of what's done so far:
- scaled embedding workers in eu-west by +40% (manual node add)
- enabled routing fallback to embeddings-secondary (quantized variant) for non-urgent traffic
- disabled recent deploy (roll back 2026-03-15T21:50) from canary -> full for embeddings-worker 1.3.2
- warming kv-cache for hot prefixes (started cache prefill run)

Jing: +1 on rollback, I left one small probe rolling against the canary to validate. results: ~10% better success for short payloads but large payloads still time out.

Priya: customer-facing note drafted, waiting for sign-off. AcmeCorp is on hold; support ticket #SUP-9123 created, flagged for engineering escalation.

Samir: current mitigations in-progress and open actions:
- Priya: send CS update with ETA ~30m (if we keep rollback and scale)
- Jing: verify route propogation to secondary and confirm latency delta (cmd below)
- Elena: watch autoscaler, do not trigger aggressive downscale until incident cleared

Elena: will hold downscales. putting a 60m override on the autoscaler group eu-west-embeds.

Jing: running quick healthcheck, logs show repeated kqueue timeouts on worker-7, suspect NIC flapping on that host. tail of logs: 
```
2026-03-15T22:03:58Z ERROR worker-7 kv-store timeout seq=1845 err=EIO read: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T22:04:02Z WARN worker-7 retrying request payload_size=1.2MB
```

Samir: if NIC flapping confirmed, plan B is to cordon worker-7 and redirect traffic. Jing — can you cordon and drain? use this command: `k8s-drain eu-west worker-7 --grace 120` and then `reroute embed-prod -> embeds-secondary` until node healthy.

Jing: ack. cordon/drain started at 22:14 UTC. reroute executed at 22:17 UTC. I see error-rate drop from 3.2x -> 1.4x but still above baseline.

PagerDuty: Escalation policy: next escalation to SRE lead at 22:44 UTC if error-rate > 1.5x.

Samir: coverage notes for handoff — primary: Jing (staying on until 23:30 UTC), secondary: Priya (on-call now but will take customer comms/from 23:00 UTC). After 23:30 UTC, Elena will be primary until morning shift. I will be reachable as backup.

Priya: logging the runbook pointers here — Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-high-5xx and Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/routing-fallback. Key sections: 'drain-and-reroute', 'cache-prefill', 'customer-comm-template'.

Elena: gap — EU-west hardware team taking >30m to confirm NIC replacement ETA; if we don't see node healthy by 23:00 UTC, we should consider cross-region spill (eu-central) for top-tier customers. that needs ops approval.

Samir: cross-region spill threshold: sustained error-rate >1.5x for 20 minutes affecting >2 customers. currently only 2 customers but still above threshold, monitor.

Jing: quick note on metrics dashboards accessed: https://metrics.redwood/eu-west/embeddings (dashboard: p99 latency, 5xx rate, queue depth). watching p95 and queue depth particularly.

Priya: customer comm posted to AcmeCorp support thread: "We're actively mitigating an issue with embeddings in EU-West. You may see intermittent failures. We're prioritizing your uploads and will follow up in ~30 minutes with status."

Samir: remaining open items for next shift/hand-off:
- Confirm worker-7 NIC replacement status or permanent cordon (Elena/Jing)
- Watch 5xx rate -> target <1.1x baseline (Jing primary)
- CS updates every 30m until cleared (Priya)
- Decide on cross-region spill if rate doesn't normalize by 23:00 UTC (Samir/Elena)

Elena: adding runbook anchor: incident checklist step 4 — "Notify platform-security if routing fallback exposes logs to secondary region" — will do if we trigger eu-central spill.

Samir: final: leaving a short play-by-play in thread as things change. please react :eyes: when you pick up primary duties. leaving at 22:30 UTC.

Jing: :eyes: took primary. continuing monitoring. will update every 15m or on notable changes.

Priya: :white_check_mark: will handle customer comms and update here on each CS update.

OpsBot: NOTE: PagerDuty reminder scheduled at 22:44 UTC per escalation policy.

Elena: logging handoff in oncall notes doc: https://confluence.redwood/ops/oncall/handoffs/6432109876 — please add any post-incident follow-ups there.

Samir: thanks team — over and out for the handoff.
